templates.title: A narrower route for blood
templates.description: Follow directional flow through a simplified vessel lumen.
templates.limitations: Longitudinal schematic, not a measured stenosis. No pressure, perfusion or turbulence model.

narrowing.description: Fractional reduction in illustrated central lumen diameter; not a clinical measurement.

speed.description: Visual flow multiplier, not blood velocity.

templates.title: Two gases. Opposite directions.
templates.description: See oxygen and carbon dioxide cross the alveolar-capillary interface.
templates.limitations: Ten enlarged alveolar air spaces and their capillary bed are an original teaching schematic. Cell layers, diffusion rates, partial pressures and ventilation-perfusion relationships are not calculated.

templates.title: One circuit. Two pumps.
templates.description: Trace the order of chambers, lungs and systemic tissues.
templates.limitations: Flow-network diagram, not anatomical placement. Valves and coronary circulation are omitted. Blue is a low-oxygen convention; blood is not blue.

speed.description: Circuit animation multiplier, not cardiac output.

templates.title: Read the electrical sequence
templates.description: A synthetic P-QRS-T waveform links labels to electrical events.
templates.limitations: Synthetic, uncalibrated waveform, not a patient trace, diagnostic rhythm or clinical lead. Grid spacing has no mm, mV or paper-speed meaning.

bpm.description: Cursor cycles per minute. This is an illustrative setting, not a normal-range recommendation.

gain.description: Visual amplitude multiplier; not mV calibration.

templates.title: Regenerate the signal at nodes
templates.description: A myelinated axon highlights successive nodes of Ranvier.
templates.limitations: No membrane-voltage, ionic-current or conduction-velocity simulation. Myelin opacity changes appearance only, not disease severity.

myelinOpacity.description: Presentation opacity only; not a demyelination model.

templates.title: From electrical to chemical
templates.description: Follow vesicle release, movement through the cleft and receptor binding.
templates.limitations: Generic chemical synapse. Calcium entry, vesicle recycling, receptor kinetics and transmitter clearance are omitted; binding does not guarantee a new action potential.

releaseCount.description: Illustrative particle count, rounded to a whole number; not transmitter concentration.

templates.title: Filter. Reclaim. Secrete.
templates.description: Separate glomerular filtration from two-way tubular exchange.
templates.limitations: Functional schematic, not complete nephron anatomy. Tubular segments, selectivity, concentrations and filtration rates are omitted. Cells and large proteins are not depicted crossing the filter.

templates.title: Across the cell membrane
templates.description: Compare facilitated diffusion with a generic ATP-coupled pump.
templates.limitations: A generic uncharged solute is assumed. Electrochemical gradients, stoichiometry, secondary active transport and membrane potential are not modeled.

mode.description: Passive: higher to lower concentration. Active: lower to higher with ATP coupling.

templates.title: From bloodstream to tissue
templates.description: Track rolling, adhesion, transmigration and tissue-directed movement.
templates.limitations: Qualitative sequence only. Specific adhesion molecules, inflammatory mediators, vessel subtypes and disease-specific changes are omitted.

templates.title: Repair happens in overlapping phases
templates.description: Watch a conceptual wound progress from clot formation to remodeling.
templates.limitations: Compressed illustrative timeline, not days or a clinical prognosis. Wound geometry, cell numbers and scar size are arbitrary; healing is not always uncomplicated.

woundWidth.description: Initial drawing width in SVG units, not wound dimensions.

templates.title: Three bacterial shapes
templates.description: Compare cocci, bacilli and spirilla with clean, original schematic geometry.
templates.limitations: Conceptual silhouettes only. Size, staining, motility and species identification are not represented.

mode.description: Highlight one morphology or show all three.

templates.title: A cell moves through a cycle
templates.description: Follow the major phases G1, S, G2 and M in order.
templates.limitations: Timing, checkpoints and tissue-specific variation are simplified. The diagram is not a live-cell measurement.

templates.title: An epithelial barrier controls passage
templates.description: Show cells, tight junctions and the difference between transcellular and paracellular routes.
templates.limitations: Illustrates organization, not permeability coefficients or a specific organ epithelium.

junctionIntegrity.description: Visual junction continuity; not a clinical permeability value.

templates.title: Thin filaments slide past thick filaments
templates.description: Visualize a simplified sarcomere with actin, myosin and Z discs.
templates.limitations: No calcium, ATP, cross-bridge cycle or force calculation. Geometry is a conceptual longitudinal view.

overlap.description: Visual overlap between actin and myosin.

templates.title: An action potential changes membrane voltage
templates.description: Trace resting state, depolarization, repolarization and the refractory period.
templates.limitations: Ion-channel timing and voltage values are qualitative. No patch-clamp data or disease inference is shown.

templates.title: Negative feedback stabilizes a hormone axis
templates.description: Show a simple hypothalamus–pituitary–target gland control loop.
templates.limitations: Generic axis only. It does not represent a specific hormone, dose, disease or laboratory result.

feedbackStrength.description: Visual strength of the feedback arrow.

templates.title: A clotting response builds a fibrin mesh
templates.description: Follow a simplified injury-to-fibrin sequence without dosing or treatment claims.
templates.limitations: Many coagulation factors and regulatory steps are omitted. This is not a test result or a treatment guide.

activation.description: Visual activation level, not a clotting measurement.

templates.title: The bicarbonate buffer links CO2 and pH
templates.description: Show the reversible carbonic-acid and bicarbonate relationships.
templates.limitations: Qualitative chemistry only. No blood-gas values, compensation formula or patient interpretation is provided.

templates.title: An antibody recognizes a matching antigen
templates.description: Illustrate recognition and neutralization as reusable immune-system pieces.
templates.limitations: Generic recognition model. Affinity, isotypes, complement and clinical protection are not quantified.

binding.description: Visual match confidence; not an affinity constant.

templates.title: Apoptosis packages a cell for removal
templates.description: Show a simplified sequence of cell shrinkage, nuclear condensation and apoptotic bodies.
templates.limitations: Conceptual morphology only. It does not diagnose disease or distinguish every form of cell death.

progress.description: Visual progression through the schematic sequence.

templates.title: A cell engulfs a large particle
templates.description: Show recognition, membrane wrapping and internalization during phagocytosis.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

progress.description: Presentation progress through the engulfment sequence.

templates.title: DNA opens; two copies form
templates.description: Show a simplified replication fork with complementary strands extending from a parental template.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

progress.description: Presentation progress from fork opening to daughter strands.

templates.title: DNA information becomes RNA
templates.description: Animate a transcription bubble and an RNA strand growing 5′→3′ from a DNA template.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

progress.description: Visual movement of the transcription bubble and RNA.

templates.title: Ribosome builds a polypeptide
templates.description: Show a ribosome moving along mRNA while amino acids join into a growing chain.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

templates.title: The active site has a competitor
templates.description: Animate substrate binding and competitive inhibitor occupancy of an enzyme active site.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

templates.title: Water follows free-water gradient
templates.description: Show water crossing a semipermeable membrane while solute remains largely on one side.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

gradient.description: Visual strength of the water gradient.

templates.title: A proton gradient powers ATP synthase
templates.description: Show protons moving through ATP synthase to drive ATP formation across the inner mitochondrial membrane.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

progress.description: Visual proton flow and ATP formation progress.

templates.title: A wave moves the bolus forward
templates.description: Animate alternating contraction and relaxation around a digestive tube.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

templates.title: Bile breaks fat into droplets
templates.description: Animate large lipid globules becoming smaller droplets that expose more surface to digestive enzymes.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

progress.description: Visual breakup of one large fat globule.

templates.title: Lymph returns tissue fluid to blood
templates.description: Show interstitial fluid entering lymphatic capillaries, traveling through a vessel, and returning near a vein.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

progress.description: Visual movement of lymph toward venous return.

templates.title: Valves keep venous flow one-way
templates.description: Show a venous valve opening toward the heart and closing against backflow.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

progress.description: Blend between open and closed valve positions.

templates.title: Old bone out; new bone in
templates.description: Animate osteoclast resorption followed by osteoblast deposition on the same bone surface.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

progress.description: Relative position of resorption and deposition.

templates.title: A fracture passes through repair stages
templates.description: Show a simplified fracture gap progressing from hematoma to callus and remodeled bone.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

templates.title: Filtration and reabsorption balance fluid
templates.description: Show fluid leaving a capillary at one end and returning at the other, with tissue fluid between.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

progress.description: Visual flow from filtration toward reabsorption.

templates.title: A receptor relays a signal inside the cell
templates.description: Animate ligand binding, receptor activation, second messenger spread and an intracellular response.
templates.limitations: Conceptual teaching schematic only; quantitative physiology, timing and clinical inference are omitted.

progress.description: Visual signal relay and amplification progress.

parts.title: Coccus bacterium
parts.description: A rounded bacterial cell silhouette for morphology scenes.
parts.limitations: Shape-only schematic; not a species or staining claim.

parts.title: Bacillus bacterium
parts.description: A rod-shaped bacterial cell silhouette.
parts.limitations: Shape-only schematic; dimensions, spores and motility are omitted.

parts.title: Spirillum bacterium
parts.description: A curved spiral bacterial cell silhouette.
parts.limitations: Shape-only schematic; flagella and species identity are not represented.

parts.title: Animal cell
parts.description: A compact animal-cell silhouette with membrane, nucleus and organelles.
parts.limitations: Selected organelles are illustrative and not to scale.

parts.title: Nucleus
parts.description: A nucleus with envelope, nucleolus and chromatin marks.
parts.limitations: Nuclear organization is schematic and not a microscopy reconstruction.

parts.title: Mitochondrion
parts.description: An elongated mitochondrion with folded inner membrane.
parts.limitations: Cristae and membrane spaces are simplified; no ATP rate is implied.

parts.title: Epithelial cell
parts.description: A polarized epithelial cell with an apical surface and basal edge.
parts.limitations: Generic cell silhouette; tissue-specific junctions and polarity markers are omitted.

parts.title: Cell membrane
parts.description: A phospholipid-bilayer fragment with hydrophilic heads and hydrophobic core.
parts.limitations: Molecular arrangement is conceptual and not a molecular-scale drawing.

parts.title: DNA double helix
parts.description: A compact DNA helix with paired bases.
parts.limitations: Base sequence and molecular dimensions are not encoded.

parts.title: Neuron
parts.description: A neuron with soma, dendrites and a myelinated axon path.
parts.limitations: Signal direction is illustrative; no electrophysiology is calculated.

parts.title: Red blood cell
parts.description: A biconcave red-cell silhouette.
parts.limitations: No cell count, oxygen saturation or disease state is represented.

parts.title: White blood cell
parts.description: A leukocyte with a lobed nucleus.
parts.limitations: Generic leukocyte; lineage and activation state are not identified.

parts.title: Alveolar cluster
parts.description: A cluster of ten lobulated alveolar air spaces wrapped by a thin capillary mesh.
parts.limitations: Conceptual ten-space cluster; individual cell layers, surface area, diffusion rates and ventilation-perfusion relationships are not calculated.

parts.title: Artery cross-section
parts.description: A simplified vessel cross-section with wall layers and lumen.
parts.limitations: Wall layers are simplified and not a histological diagnosis.

parts.title: Membrane receptor
parts.description: A receptor embedded in a membrane with an external binding site.
parts.limitations: Binding and downstream signaling are generic and not pathway-specific.

parts.title: Chemical synapse
parts.description: A presynaptic terminal, cleft and postsynaptic receptors.
parts.limitations: Release and receptor response are schematic; no transmitter concentration is implied.

parts.title: Bone cross-section
parts.description: A compact bone fragment with a simplified trabecular pattern.
parts.limitations: Generic bone texture; cortical and cancellous regions are not separated.

parts.title: Scalpel
parts.description: A simple scalpel silhouette for procedural illustrations.
parts.limitations: Generic instrument silhouette; no manufacturer or size is represented.

parts.title: Syringe
parts.description: A syringe with barrel, plunger and needle.
parts.limitations: No medication, dose or route is shown.

parts.title: Suture and needle
parts.description: A curved surgical needle with thread for wound-closure scenes.
parts.limitations: Closure technique, tissue tension and material properties are not represented.

parts.title: Pituitary gland
parts.description: A compact pituitary gland silhouette with anterior and posterior lobes and a stalk.
parts.limitations: Gross-anatomy schematic; lobes, vascular connections and hormone pathways are simplified.

parts.title: Clavicle
parts.description: An S-shaped clavicle silhouette with enlarged sternal and acromial ends.
parts.limitations: Single-bone gross-anatomy schematic; side, landmarks and fracture patterns are not represented.

parts.title: Trachea
parts.description: A tracheal tube with cartilage rings and a simplified bifurcation into main bronchi.
parts.limitations: Airway schematic; cartilage composition, mucosa, dimensions and airflow are not to scale.

parts.title: Thyroid gland
parts.description: A butterfly-shaped thyroid silhouette wrapped around a short tracheal segment.
parts.limitations: Gross-anatomy schematic; lobe proportions, isthmus thickness and parathyroids are not shown to scale.

parts.title: Brainstem
parts.description: A simplified brainstem with midbrain, pons, medulla and a cerebellar contour.
parts.limitations: Orientation and nuclei are simplified; this is a gross educational silhouette, not a neuroanatomy atlas.

parts.title: Longitudinal vessel segment
parts.description: A configurable artery, vein or capillary segment with named attachments and optional valve.
parts.limitations: Longitudinal educational schematic; wall layers, pressure, velocity and histology are not to scale.

valve.description: Show a venous valve leaf pair.

parts.title: Path-based blood flow
parts.description: Reusable deterministic red-cell particles moving along a supplied polyline.
parts.limitations: Particles illustrate direction and continuity only; no blood velocity, viscosity or cell deformability is calculated.

parts.title: Attachment-aware arrow
parts.description: An arrow connecting named attachment points in a composed scene.
parts.limitations: Annotation geometry communicates a declared relationship; it does not infer anatomy or causality.

parts.title: Attachment-aware label
parts.description: A concise label placed beside a named attachment point.
parts.limitations: Label placement is schematic and does not encode a measured anatomical landmark.

parts.title: Platelet
parts.description: A small activated platelet silhouette with granule marks.
parts.limitations: Generic platelet icon; activation state and granule contents are not quantified.

parts.title: Fibrin mesh
parts.description: A reusable cross-linked fibrin network whose density follows deterministic progress.
parts.limitations: Network topology is illustrative; clot strength, factor concentrations and lysis are omitted.

parts.title: Layered tissue
parts.description: Three distinct tissue layers with named attachment edges for wound scenes.
parts.limitations: Generic educational layers; cell types, thickness and histological diagnosis are not represented.

parts.title: Fibroblast
parts.description: A spindle-shaped fibroblast with a central nucleus for repair compositions.
parts.limitations: Cell silhouette only; collagen synthesis rate and lineage are not represented.

parts.title: Macrophage
parts.description: An irregular macrophage silhouette with pseudopods for an inflammation scene.
parts.limitations: Generic immune-cell silhouette; polarization, cytokines and phagocytic rate are not represented.

parts.title: Plaque overlay
parts.description: A configurable plaque shelf that narrows a vessel lumen without replacing vessel geometry.
parts.limitations: Conceptual overlay; composition, calcification, rupture and clinical risk are not represented.

parts.title: Heart schematic
parts.description: A compact four-chamber heart with great-vessel attachment points.
parts.limitations: Schematic heart only; chamber volumes, valves, coronary anatomy and electrical timing are omitted.

parts.title: Nephron schematic
parts.description: A nephron loop with glomerulus, tubule, loop and collecting duct attachments.
parts.limitations: Schematic nephron; filtration, reabsorption, secretion and concentration are not calculated.
